title: Close-area reactive planners: APF with wall-follow escape and VFH+, range sensor only, 72-beam vs Crazyflie-like 4-beam fan
summary: Map-free fallback planners for close-area A=>B, written as close-area-arena Planners that read only the pose and the range scan. apf.py: velocity-form artificial potential field on raw returns (attractive goal, repulsive returns weighted by each beam's share of the circle), a range-only brake, and a named escape rule, wall-follow after 3 s of no progress with a Bug-style leave rule; escape=False gives plain APF. vfh_plus.py: VFH+ with a 72-sector polar histogram, enlargement by radius plus safety distance, binary histogram with hysteresis, valley selection with the goal / heading / previous-direction cost, speed from obstacle density, no escape rule. bench.py runs both on the arena's random, u_trap and narrow_gap families with the default 72-beam 6 m fan and a 4-beam 4 m Multi-ranger-like fan, scores on truth, and classifies where failed runs ended (inside the U cup, before the gap wall, at the gap). tune.py holds the dev-seed sweep that set the defaults. Synthetic arena only.
verified: ran 2026-11-09 with CPython 3.11.15 + numpy 2.4.6 / scipy 1.17.1 on an Apple M3 Max, in the sample venv (requirements.txt reuses the arena's): bench.py --layouts 50 --seed 0 ran twice with identical per-run scores in all 18 cells (planner timings excluded), wall 75.8 s for the kept run; tune.py on seed 1 wrote results/dev_seed1_tuning.md. Every number in README is from results/. test_smoke.py: 1 passed in the venv, 1 skipped under plain python3 3.14 without numpy. No arena file was edited. Layouts, vehicle and sensor are simulated; the 4-beam fan is a geometry model of the Multi-ranger (no beam cone, arena noise and dropout); no SITL, no Crazyflie.
shows: APF (wall-follow escape) and VFH+ from range returns only, on random, U-trap and narrow-gap layouts, with a 72-beam fan and a Crazyflie-like 4-beam fan; where each gets stuck or collides
runtime: ~76 s for 50 layouts x 3 families x 2 fans x 3 planner variants
key_result: [50 layouts per cell, seed 0](README.md#results-ran-2026-11-09-apple-m3-max-cpython-31115-numpy-246-scipy-1171): 72 beams: APF with wall-follow escape reached 92 % on u_trap (2 % without escape, VFH+ 0 %), but 0 % on narrow_gap where VFH+ reached 62 %; 4 beams: collisions 8-54 % for APF and 72-98 % for VFH+
